newsitem.title: USA: North American bunker prices holding steady.
newsitem.headline: North American bunker prices holding steady.

text.p: North American bunker prices were still holding steady Thursday even on the West Coast which has seen more upside volatility than other markets in the region, traders said.
"It's still a sideways market," said one trader. We're going nowhere fast. It's the least volatility I've seen in quite a while," he added.

But West Coast traders said the Los Angeles market, while terribly steady on Thursday, remained poised to head higher in the hear future due to a recent lack of cargo activity that could tighten bunker markets there in the near future.
A deal for 180 CST in New York was heard done at $109 a tonne, while 380 CST material in New York was pegged at about $103 a tonne, traders said.
In Houston, 380 CST bunkers were steady at $94 a tonne and 180 CST was at $96 a tonne.
Los Angeles prices were completely unchanged between $96 and $98 for 380 CST and between $100 and $102 for 180 CST.
Seattle markets were too thinly discussed to reliably peg, traders said.
-- Oliver Ludwig New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1633
